## Summary

Explain what changed and why. Link the issue or evidence record if applicable.

## User-visible behavior

Describe public pages, sources, exports, and documentation affected. Add before/after **public or synthetic** screenshots for UI changes.

## Validation

- [ ] ResourceWarning-strict test suite ran, or the reason it could not run is documented.
- [ ] Python compilation and whitespace checks ran, or exceptions are explained.
- [ ] Documentation, current status, and generated-status sync were checked where relevant.
- [ ] New or changed public links/screenshots were checked against actual committed files.
- [ ] No credentials, private source registries, raw parcel-owner records, operational URLs, or sensitive machine details were added.

## Policy and deployment boundaries

- [ ] Provider terms, cadence, and 429 handling remain within approved limits, or the required review is explicitly documented.
- [ ] Public data remains intentionally sanitized; any new fields have received security/privacy review.
- [ ] Source health, provider-check freshness, and public publication freshness remain distinct.
- [ ] No production deployment, authoritative schedule, merge, or private configuration change is being implied by this PR alone.

## Follow-up or remaining gates

List open issues, unverified acceptance paths, or approvals still needed. Do not claim that source changes are deployed until deployment evidence exists.
